data.content: Plan APPROVED. Verified read-only: replication.rs is 497/499 lines so the summary.rs carve-out is required; the only Deferred consumers are app/sync_ops.rs:126 (matches! with .., unaffected), run_commands.rs:216 (destructures active_leases, compiler-enforced update), and two test literals. Knot has no invariants. Test strategy maps 1:1 to all four verification steps and every acceptance criterion. ONE ADDENDUM for implementation: also reword SyncError::ActiveLeasesExist (src/sync/mod.rs:270) from 'terminate leases before syncing' to name the pull, since after this change only pull raises it; src/sync/error_tests.rs:100 only asserts the 'N active lease(s)' substring so the reword is safe. Accepted trade: sync_or_defer now does a publish-worktree fetch+reset even when it will defer.
